description: This file defines and exports functions for managing a plugin runtime store specific to Feishu, utilizing a generic store creation function from an external SDK and exporting runtime accessor functions.

methods.name: createPluginRuntimeStore
methods.description: A function imported from the SDK for creating a plugin runtime store with a specific key and initial message.

methods.name: getFeishuRuntime
methods.description: Function to retrieve the current Feishu runtime from the store.

methods.name: setFeishuRuntime
methods.description: Function to set or update the Feishu runtime in the store.
